description: Searches current German SIM-only mobile tariffs, or data-only tariffs, and returns them ranked, cheapest average monthly cost over 24 months first. Use it to find or compare tariffs by data volume, network, contract term, 5G, speed or provider. Returns at most 30 tariffs and the total number that match. Covers Germany only, SIM-only tariffs without a phone.

allnet_flat.description: Only tariffs with unlimited calls and texts to all German networks; ignored for data tariffs.

commitment.description: none: cancellable monthly (prepaid included). prepaid: prepaid only. contract: minimum term of 12 months or more.

kind.description: phone: tariffs with calls and texts (default). data: data-only tariffs for tablets, laptops or routers.

language.description: Language of the text fields and of the linked pages. Default de.

limit.description: Number of tariffs to return, default 10.

min_data_gb.description: Minimum high-speed data per month in GB; unlimited tariffs always qualify.

min_download_mbit.description: Minimum advertised download speed in Mbit/s.

networks.description: Any of these networks; empty for all. d-netz: resellers that promise Telekom or Vodafone without saying which.

provider.description: Only this provider, by its slug as in the provider list, e.g. winsim.

sort.description: price: average monthly cost over 24 months (default). monthly_fee: lowest first monthly fee. data: most data first. speed: fastest first.

name: search_tariffs
title: Search mobile tariffs
